title: Caraer CMS module config
description: Declares one CMS v2 module. Lives at src/app/modules/<name>/module.caraer.json next to index.astro. The fields declared here become the inputs a content editor sees in the builder sidebar, and arrive in the component as Astro.props.fields.

name.description: Stable snake_case machine name. Must match the directory name. Renaming breaks pages already using the module.

label.description: Name shown in the builder's module library.

kind.description: section composes into a page alongside others. page is a complete page in one module. header and footer fill the site-wide slots.

description.description: One-line summary shown under the label in the library picker.

category.description: Groups the module in the library picker, e.g. 'hero', 'content', 'listing'.

icon.description: Icon name shown in the library picker and the module list.

preview.description: Screenshot URL shown in the library picker.

fields.description: Editable inputs for this module, in sidebar order.

frameworks.description: UI frameworks this module's islands use, mapped to the semver range it targets. A build hoists one copy of each framework, so caraer apps push rejects a range that excludes the major pinned by the platform version.

name.description: Stable snake_case key. Becomes the property name on Astro.props.fields and is referenced by visibleWhen.

label.description: Label shown above the input in the builder sidebar.

type.description: Same field types as app settings, so the builder renders them with the widgets it already has. PROPERTY_SINGLE_SELECT binds the field to a property on the record the page belongs to: the editor picks a property, the module receives that property's value. SECRET and ACTION are not available on modules - a page document is public, and a settings-screen button has no meaning on a page.

defaultValue.description: Value used until the editor sets one.

hidden.description: Never shown in the sidebar. The value is still stored and passed to the module.

visibleWhen.description: Show this field only while every condition holds.

allowedPropertyTypes.description: Restricts a PROPERTY_* picker to properties of these types.

allowedPropertyFormats.description: Restricts a PROPERTY_* picker to properties of these formats.

field.description: Name of a sibling field on this module.
